title: duscope_delete
description: The arguments of duscope_delete, which runs `duscope clean --from` on each item's handle, as a dry run unless dry_run is false; the Trash only, and offered only under the server's --allow-delete.

items.description: The entries to move to the Trash, at most 100: all of them, or, if any is refused, none

handle.description: The handle duscope_explain returned for the entry; it holds fifteen minutes and only while the path still holds the entry explain examined

expect_bytes.description: The bytes this entry should free once the Trash is emptied: its frees_bytes from a dry-run plan, or duscope_explain's freeable_now_bytes. Off by more than 1%, the item is refused

dry_run.description: true (the default): answer the plan and move nothing. false: move the items to the Trash, nothing else
